description: Extract print templates into separate HTML files, fix print alignment, and update the CRM to use the new templates - all as one cohesive change.
steps: Step 1: Create public/receipt.html - A standalone HTML file containing the Consultation Fee Receipt (parashmrsh shulk raseed). Copy the EXACT content from the #print-receipt div in public/index.html. The HTML file must: (a) be a complete standalone HTML page with proper DOCTYPE, head, charset, (b) include all the print-area CSS styles inline for proper rendering, (c) keep every Hindi/English word EXACTLY as-is from the existing template, (d) use JavaScript at the bottom that reads URL query parameters (or receives data via window.opener/postMessage) to fill the span fields (pr-receiptNo, pr-date, pr-place, pr-name, pr-mobile, pr-aadhaar, pr-payMode, pr-utr, pr-sig-name), (e) leave signature sections blank for physical signing, (f) auto-trigger window.print() after fields are filled, (g) reference logo.jpg (same directory), (h) fix print alignment: use proper @page margins (12mm top/bottom, 15mm left/right), ensure table columns don't overflow, use appropriate font sizes for A4 printing.

Step 2: Create public/agreement.html - A standalone HTML file containing BOTH the Loan Agreement AND the PDC Receipt (they print together with a page-break between them). Copy the EXACT content from the #print-agreement div in public/index.html. The HTML file must: (a) be a complete standalone HTML page, (b) include all print-area CSS styles inline, (c) keep every Hindi/English word EXACTLY as-is, (d) use JavaScript to read URL query parameters to fill all span fields (ag-name, ag-aadhaar, ag-address, ag-mobile, ag-loanAmt, ag-loanAmtWords, ag-date, ag-place, ag-successFee, ag-successFeeWords, ag-chequeNo, ag-chequeBankBranch, ag-chequeHolder, ag-chequeAmt, ag-chequeDate, ag-decl-name, ag-sig-name, ag-sig-aadhaar, pdc-date, pdc-name, pdc-mobile, pdc-aadhaar, pdc-chequeNo, pdc-chequeBankBranch, pdc-chequeAmt, pdc-chequeDate, pdc-receipt-date, pdc-sig-name), (e) leave ALL signature/thumb impression areas blank, (f) auto-trigger window.print() after filling, (g) reference logo.jpg, (h) include the page-break div between agreement and PDC receipt, (i) fix print alignment: proper @page margins, table-layout: fixed with appropriate column widths, prevent content overflow, ensure readable font sizes on A4.

Step 3: Update the printReceipt() and printAgreement() functions in public/index.html to open the new template files in a new window/tab, passing customer data as URL query parameters. The new approach: (a) Build a query string from customer object fields, (b) Use window.open('receipt.html?' + params, '_blank') or window.open('agreement.html?' + params, '_blank'), (c) Keep the existing embedded print areas as fallback OR remove them since the separate files replace them - remove the embedded #print-receipt and #print-agreement divs and their associated @media print CSS that hides everything, since the new separate HTML files handle printing independently.

Step 4: Fix the print CSS in both new HTML template files to ensure clean A4 output: (a) @page { size: A4 portrait; margin: 12mm 15mm; } for balanced margins, (b) All .doc-table use table-layout: fixed with explicit column widths and word-wrap: break-word, (c) .sig-table cells get proper width: 50% and adequate padding, (d) Font sizes: body 10.5pt, headings 11-15pt, table cells 10pt - ensuring readability without overflow, (e) Remove any padding/margin on body for print so @page margin is the only spacing, (f) Ensure .page-break works correctly with break-before: page, (g) Test that no content is clipped at edges.
acceptance_criteria: public/receipt.html exists as a standalone, valid HTML file containing the exact same wording as the original #print-receipt section
public/agreement.html exists as a standalone, valid HTML file containing the exact same wording as the original #print-agreement section (including PDC receipt)
Both template files accept customer data via URL query parameters and auto-fill all data fields
Signature and thumb impression areas remain blank in both templates
The printReceipt() and printAgreement() functions in index.html now open the separate template files
Print output is properly aligned for A4 with correct margins, no overflow, readable fonts
server.js still serves all files correctly from /public (no changes needed since Express static middleware handles it)
The CRM main page (index.html) still functions correctly for all CRUD operations
verification: Run 'npm install' in /projects/sandbox/Reception-CRM to confirm dependencies install
Run 'node -e "const app = require('./server.js')"' or start the server briefly to confirm no syntax errors
Verify public/receipt.html exists and is valid HTML (check for DOCTYPE, closing tags)
Verify public/agreement.html exists and is valid HTML
Verify that the word content in receipt.html matches the original #print-receipt exactly
Verify that the word content in agreement.html matches the original #print-agreement exactly
Verify index.html printReceipt/printAgreement functions use window.open with query params
